versions.changelog:
Initial release v1.0.0:
- Complete swap flow: /swap (GET calldata) + /broadcast-transaction (POST signed tx)
- ERC-20 approval handling with signatureData parsing
- MEV sandwich protection support (ETH, BSC, SOL, BASE)
- Solana Jito tips integration
- Auto-slippage and price impact protection
- Commission/referral fee splitting
- Production-ready Python client with full type annotations
- Python and Node.js complete examples
